verdict.rationale: Make documents a REST API with per-resource reference pages, a TypeScript SDK, and an llms.txt index, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe of the usual OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 everywhere. Markdown reference pages and llms.txt are adjacent documentation formats, not a machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
